metadata.name: improve-agent-native
metadata.description: Check if a repository or agent-facing product surface is ready for AI coding agents. Use when you need to audit repo agent compatibility, review AGENTS.md, find missing test/build commands, evaluate docs quality, assess tool/action parity, or produce a file-evidence scorecard with specific fixes.
metadata.short_description: Check repo readiness for AI coding agents.

checks.name: basic_requirement_rubric
checks.policy: Every Skills SDK contract must define observable quality criteria and evidence requirements for the skill's basic job before handoff.

checks.name: analytic_rubric_quality
checks.policy: Skills SDK rubric criteria must use an analytic rubric shape. Shared criteria may come from centralized rubric_profile entries; skill-local criteria should only add selectors or domain-specific overrides.

checks.name: orphaned_bundle_reference
checks.policy: When a knowledge capsule manifest exists, bundle support files must be routed by SKILL.md, capsule routing, or package contracts.

evidence.policy: Procedural skills should not split the same safety, validation, and handoff obligations across overlapping boundary sections.

values.purpose: Check whether a repository and any agent-facing product or workflow surface are ready for AI coding agents to follow guidance, use relevant capabilities, run checks, recover from failure, and leave useful proof.
inputs: facet selected from the knowledge capsule manifest when pack-backed judgment is needed
audit mode: scorecard, recommendations, AGENTS audit, docs audit, validation-entrypoint audit, proof-loop audit, action-parity audit, tool-design audit, dynamic-context audit, or source trace
outputs: facet selected and the exact capsule reference path used when pack-backed judgment informs the answer
capability parity, primitive tool design, dynamic context, shared workspace, execution-signal, and outcome-test gaps when applicable
values.evidence_policy: Report exact files inspected, commands run, outcomes, and blockers.

knowledge_capsules.policy: Knowledge capsule manifests select bounded generated capsules, but capsule use rules should be promoted into a first-party skill reference so agents see them without relying on buried capsule text.

operating_model_formats.policy: Skills that name durable workspace artifacts must preserve their operating-model docs as package-local references instead of compressing them into SKILL.md.

source_operating_model.policy: When source-context declares operating-model source material, the package must preserve it as package-local references and route agents to it through Progressive Disclosure.

progressive_disclosure.progressive_disclosure_policy: Keep SKILL.md as the compact entrypoint and route task-specific details and source operating-model docs to existing references.

identity_and_assets.policy: Skill names should be stable kebab-case handles; descriptions should use natural action-trigger language; references and scripts should be purpose-named and browseable.

knowledge_capsules.policy: Knowledge capsule manifests select bounded generated capsules, but capsule use rules should be promoted into a first-party skill reference so agents see them without relying on buried capsule text.

agent_contract.workflow_policy: SKILL.md remains the judgment layer; workflows/skillflow.json is optional deterministic mechanics. Runtime adaptation inside declared graph bounds may be autonomous; durable graph amendments require review.
agent_contract.optimization_policy: Skill optimization may produce bounded candidate artifacts and rejected-edit evidence. Canonical SKILL.md promotion requires declared gates, anti-cheat checks, and review.
agent_contract.agent_toml_policy: optional_per_skill_runtime_profiles; required only when the skill contract declares a dedicated subagent or persona runtime

skill_package_verification.agent_summary: Package verification passed without install, extraction, or runtime-root mutation.

rollback_journal.reason: Directory verification is read-only and performs no extraction or install.

skill_package_verification.rollback_hint: Directory verification is read-only. Package archive verification must pass before install mutation.
